method: Compare each synthetic ground-truth definition against the frozen tactical opportunity protocol. This is specification conformance, not annotation of real races and not estimation of real-world rates.

material_defects.mechanism: line leader attacks into open forward space; follower remains attached
material_defects.protocol_conflict: INITIATIVE_CONFLICT eligibility requires the forward path to reach an already occupied/defended forward position. Open forward space is not an eligible conflict opportunity.

material_defects.mechanism: solo leader takes open forward space without contest
material_defects.protocol_conflict: A solo rider has no identifiable direct expected follower, so BANTE_FOLLOW is INELIGIBLE. Open forward space also fails INITIATIVE_CONFLICT eligibility.

checks_passed: Downstream Pass B labels do not create or delete Pass A anchors.
UNKNOWN is represented separately from PRESENT and ABSENT.
INELIGIBLE is represented separately from UNKNOWN.
Six-second BANTE recovery boundary is represented on both sides of the cutoff.
Terminal sprint, momentary overlap, commentary-only inference, continuity failure, zero-anchor, multi-anchor, and non-independent continuation cases are present.
Direct expected follower semantics are explicitly tested in three-rider line cases.
cautions: The 22/24 conformance score measures the authored test cases against the protocol; it is not annotator accuracy and not a real-world performance metric.
Case frequencies are intentionally constructed and cannot be used as tactical prevalence.
No finish order, payout, odds, ROI, model selection, or Reality transition truth is authorized from this result.
next_action: Create corrected T0 v2 with the two defects repaired, re-run conformance to require 24/24 before escalating to T1 observation ambiguity.
